ecrans.titre: Sign in to a site in a tab
ecrans.texte: A site’s sign-in window (Google, OAuth) opens in Escouade, on the project’s session. A link received by email pastes into the tab’s address bar.

ecrans.titre: An agent never takes your screen
ecrans.texte: When you are looking elsewhere, what it wants to show you waits under Browsers. Go back to its conversation: the tab opens beside it.

ecrans.titre: Hand your tab to an agent
ecrans.texte: In the menu of a browser you opened, Let drive… lends it to an agent of the project, who learns it from a message.
